rules: Headings must always be uppercase to mimic comic book lettering.
Use text shadow on large headings for a 'pop' effect (e.g., text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #0a0a0a).
Body text should be highly legible, avoiding extreme stylization to maintain scanability.

rules: Use heavy padding inside containers with thick borders to prevent text collision.
Containers and hero elements should often use negative skew (skew-x-[-5deg]) to convey speed and action.
Overlap elements intentionally, mimicking comic book characters breaking out of panels.
Do not center everything; use dynamic, diagonal, or strong left/right alignments.

images.description: Explosive comic burst background with halftones for the landing page hero section.
Sci-fi 3D arena for the main menu/lobby background behind the UI.
Abstract pop art texture to be used selectively as section backgrounds or in the match end screen.
3D cel-shaded comic character to place dynamically in the lobby or hero section, overlapping panels.

icons.styling: Use thick stroke-width (2.5 or 3) to match the bold comic aesthetic.

landing_page.hero: Full screen with 'hero_background'. Massive H1 heading skewed, overlapping a 'hero_character' image. Giant Play Now button with heavy offset shadow.
landing_page.branding: Thick black outlines on everything. Use an SVG halftone overlay on the body.

authentication.layout: Centered comic panel card. White background, 4px solid black border, 8px solid black offset shadow.
authentication.inputs: Thick bordered inputs, labels in all-caps.

main_menu_lobby.layout: Left side: Vertical list of skewed menu buttons (Play, Loadout, Profile, Leaderboard) with hover pop effects. Right side: 'hero_character' overlapping the UI.
main_menu_lobby.hud: Top right: Player profile summary. Bottom right: Social/Settings.

in_game_hud.health_bar: Bottom left. Angled container (skewed). Red/Yellow fill with thick black border. Large font for HP numbers.
in_game_hud.ammo: Bottom right. Huge 'Anton' font numbers, thick outline.
in_game_hud.kill_feed: Top right. Small slanted black banners with white text.

match_end_scoreboard.splash: Use 'ui_texture_overlay'. Massive VICTORY or DEFEAT text in 'Bangers' font, yellow and blue styling.
match_end_scoreboard.table: Bento grid style. Each player row is a comic panel (border-black border-2, alternating backgrounds).

interactions_and_motion.hover: Elements scale slightly and offset shadows increase (mimicking a 'pop' off the page).
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use fast, snappy transitions. No slow, smooth fades—comic motion is punchy.
interactions_and_motion.effects: Consider using Framer Motion to slide panels in from the edges on page load (like turning a comic page).

technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes but heavily rely on custom drop-shadows and borders to achieve the neo-brutalist comic look.
For the halftone effect, create a reusable Tailwind utility or a global CSS class referencing the radial-gradient pattern provided in the surfaces object.
Ensure all fonts are imported properly (e.g., from Google Fonts: Bangers, Anton, Outfit).
Ensure 3D Three.js game canvas sits at z-index 0, and the Meta UI sits on top (z-10 or higher) with a transparent background.
All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' following kebab-case (e.g., 'play-match-button').
Override default Shadcn styles if used: remove subtle borders and radiuses, replace with thick 4px black borders, square corners, and solid offset shadows.
